title: PENet detects pulmonary embolism on volumetric CT angiography
summary: PENet, a 3D deep-learning model for pulmonary embolism on CT angiography, reached AUROC 0.84 on an internal hold-out test and 0.85 on data from one unnamed external institution. The abstract does not report sensitivity, specificity or study size, and the external validation is limited to a single site.
ai_technology: PENet, 3D deep convolutional network on volumetric CT

evidence.tested: PENet, a 3D CNN, was tested on a hold-out set from the training institution (AUROC 0.84) and on an external institution (AUROC 0.85), and was compared with other state-of-the-art 3D CNN models.
evidence.unknown: The abstract states no limitations; external validation covers one institution and sensitivity, specificity and study size are not reported.
evidence.ai_role: A 77-layer 3D CNN, pretrained on Kinetics-600, detected pulmonary embolism on CT angiography and is proposed as a triage tool.
